subject: First Facebook exchange with Alexis Armel, Sept 21 2008 (her three messages; his replies not in notifications)
note: Facebook notification emails — they capture only the correspondent's messages, not Dan's own replies. Direction is unambiguous: all three are FROM Alexis TO Dan, sent the afternoon of Sept 21, 2008 (13:50, 15:35, 17:19 ET), the day he drove to Florida (drive photo EXIF 06:55 that morning). Her opener responds to his farewell blast note. The full two-sided exchange survives separately in Dan's Feb 25, 2010 self-forward ('First ever msg's between D & A <333').
